ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَانْزَعْ مِنْ قُلُوْبِنَا حُبَّ الشَّهَوَاتِ وَ الْأَغْرَاضِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wanza` min qulūbinā ḥubba sh-shahawāti wa ‘l-aghrāḍ.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and remove from our hearts love of base desires and prejudice!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الْمُطَهَّرَةِ قُلُوْبُهُمْ مِنَ الْأَمْرَاضِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Al-Muṭahharati qulūbuhum mina ‘l-amrāḍ.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family whose hearts are purified of all sickness!

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِۨ الْهَادِيْ إِلَى سَوَاءِ الصِّرَاطِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Āli Sayyidinā Muḥammadin, Al-Hādī ilā sawā’i ṣ-Ṣirāt.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad, the guide to the proper path!
